title: Attach lineage and test results when promoting a recipe version
narrative: New recipe versions are immutable artifacts with provenance, lineage, test results, and a reversible promotion pointer. Research and rule promotion patterns exist (`taloneth_insp_rule_promotion`); the recipe catalog now keeps versions instead of overwriting by name. Tracks MH-SR-05[^insp-sr-05].
implementation: `GraphTemplateRegistry.add_version(template, parent_version=...)` records the lineage DAG and refuses to replace a stored name+version; `attach_evaluation` / `evaluations` hang eval results on a version; `promote` and `rollback` move a reversible pointer; `merge` carries versions, lineage, evaluations, and pointer. Held-out release gates (MH-SR-07) and the evolution loop (MH-SR-06) remain separate stories.
validation: Harness `cli` `recipe_plan` loads `plans/*.yaml` (human-readable lifecycle plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
